note: The one definition of the browser matrix. playwright.config.ts builds its projects from this file and tests/Support/prepare-browser-contribution.php seeds from it, so a project cannot exist in one and be missing from the other. Adding a project here is what makes it run and what makes its fixtures exist; nothing else needs editing. `specs` is `all` for a project that runs every journey, or `right-to-left` for one confined to that spec. Only `all` projects reach the maker-checker journey, and only they need approval identities.
